I worked through all 55 rules in the generated checklist against the diff. **No rule failures.** I changed no tracked files. The only file written was the temporary checklist at `docs/engineering/pr-self-review-checklist.generated.md`, which sits under the untracked `docs/` folder.

**Scope:** 1 commit (`a874b3e35`). It touches `src/modules/spaces/domain/space-safes.repository.ts` (+4/−1) and its integration spec (+54). When a Space is already full, the "max Safes" error no longer ends with "You can only add up to 0 more."

**Rules that applied, all pass:**
- **CHANGE-01 / CHANGE-02:** the change is small and focused, with no unrelated edits.
- **CHANGE-04:** only the wording of the 400 error message changes. The status code and error type are the same.
- **NAME-01:** the new variable `remaining` says what it holds.
- **STYLE-01:** the ternary is clear without a comment, and there is no dead code.
- **TEST-02:** an integration test is the right level here. The limit check reads from the DB and the repo has no unit spec for this repository. It sits next to the existing limit test (`should fail if the number of SpaceSafes surpasses the limit`).
- **TEST-08:** the test name matches the assertion. `toThrow(new BadRequestException(msg))` compares the whole message, so the test fails if the "0 more" suffix comes back.
- **TEST-01:** the setup follows the style of the tests around it (direct `db*Repo.insert` calls and faker values).
- **License headers (AGENTS.md):** both files start with `// SPDX-License-Identifier: FSL-1.1-MIT`.

Every other rule (DB, cache, auth, config, security, logging and the rest) doesn't touch this diff. I didn't need to look up the review history behind any rule.

## Findings (advisory, none blocking)

1. **The same message in two sibling repositories still says "up to 0 more"** (REUSE-01, consistency)
   - Fixed here: `src/modules/spaces/domain/space-safes.repository.ts:48`
   - Not fixed: `src/modules/spaces/domain/address-books/address-book-items.repository.ts:184` and `src/modules/spaces/domain/address-books/user-address-book-items.repository.ts:158`
   - An e2e test expects the old text: `src/modules/spaces/routes/address-books.controller.e2e-spec.ts:522` asserts `'...maximum of 1 Address Book Items. You can only add up to 0 more.'`
   - As a result, the three Workspace limit errors now read differently.
   - CHANGE-01 is a good reason to leave the others out of this PR. Still, decide whether to fix them the same way in a follow-up. If you fix all three, a small shared message helper would be justified under PR-01.

2. **One edge case isn't tested** (TEST-09, nit)
   - `space-safes.repository.ts:48`: the `remaining > 0` check also handles the case where `maxSafesPerSpace` is lowered in config below the number of Safes a Space already has.
   - Before this change that case produced "up to -N more". No test covers it.

3. **The new test repeats setup it probably doesn't need** (TEST-01, nit)
   - `src/modules/spaces/domain/space-safes.repository.integration.spec.ts:436-455`: the test inserts a user, a wallet and a member, copied from the neighbouring test.
   - `create()` only uses `spaceId`, so a single space row is probably enough. This matches the existing style in the file, so it's optional cleanup.
